# CIEMAT — Plataforma Solar de Almería

## Snapshot

| | |
|---|---|
| **Country** | Spain |
| **City** | Tabernas (Almería) |

| **Publicly linked people** | Aránzazu Fernández-García |


## Why it matters internationally

The Plataforma Solar de Almería is Europe's flagship concentrating
solar facility, and its OPAC laboratory anchors the radiative-property
side of that mission: absorptance and emittance of receiver coatings and
reflectors, plus aging. By leading the SFERA-III intercomparison of
solar absorptance and thermal emittance measurements, PSA plays for the
applied-solar community the harmonizing role that CCT comparisons play
in metrology.

## Scope of activity

- **Quantities:** solar absorptance · thermal emittance · specular and hemispherical reflectance
- **Spectral range:** 0.28–2.5 µm (solar absorptance); 2–14 µm (thermal emittance, FTIR + integrating sphere)
- **Temperature:** room temperature (spectrophotometric); aging under concentrated solar conditions
- **Methodology:** Solar absorptance (Lambda 1050 with 150 mm integrating spheres) and thermal emittance (FTIR with integrating sphere) of receiver coatings and solar reflectors; led the SFERA-III laboratory intercomparison of solar absorptance and thermal emittance measurements.

**Application domains:** concentrating solar thermal receivers and reflectors · coating durability and aging.
